items.message: `_workflow_ids` calls `inspect.getsource(module.register)` inside `show_workflow_cmd` in two places, and also inside `_workflow_function`. Each call to `show-workflow <id>` therefore reads and regex-scans the register source twice: once in the membership check inside `show_workflow_cmd` and once inside `_workflow_function`. This is negligible at present given the tiny number of workflows, but the pattern — computing the same source scan in a helper and again in the caller — is worth noting if th…[truncated]

`inspect.getsource` is called on entire workflow modules (potentially hundreds of lines) to produce the `--registered` listing and the whole-family print paths. On a cold import path this also forces the import of both workflow modules unconditionally inside `show_workflow_cmd`. Both costs are CLI-invocation scope only and do not scale with request volume, so this is not a production hot-path concern. Noting it for completeness.
